# hush_mcp_catalog_entry (Data Source)

An entry of Hush's built-in MCP catalog: a server a `hush_mcp_application` can be created from. Read it to learn, before applying, what the application will need -- which `url_label` to pick, whether it takes `client_id` and `client_secret`, whether it runs on hosted gateways only, and the tool names `tool_operation` may set. Custom apps are not in the catalog; a `hush_custom_mcp_application` describes one of those itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hush_mcp_catalog_entry" "datadog" {
  app_catalog_id = "datadog"
}

# The labels an application's url_label may name, such as ["US1", "EU"].
output "datadog_url_labels" {
  value = data.hush_mcp_catalog_entry.datadog.urls[*].label
}

# The destructive tools, which the gateway blocks by default.
output "datadog_destructive_tools" {
  value = [for tool in data.hush_mcp_catalog_entry.datadog.tools : tool.name if tool.type == "destructive"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_catalog_id` (String) The id of the catalog entry, such as 'github'.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) The catalog category the server is listed under.
- `display_name` (String) The name the catalog shows for the server.
- `hosted` (Boolean) Whether Hush hosts the server itself. A hosted server is reachable only from gateways Hush runs, so an application made from it can only be placed on deployments of kind 'hosted'.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `manual_registration` (Boolean) Whether the server does not register OAuth clients on its own, so an application made from it needs `client_id` and `client_secret` from an OAuth app you registered with the provider.
- `oauth_relay` (Boolean) Whether the server's OAuth flow goes through Hush's relay.
- `scopes` (List of String) The OAuth scopes an application made from the entry requests by default.
- `tools` (List of Object) The tools the server offers, which an application copies when it is created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools))
- `urls` (List of Object) The addresses the server is reachable at. When there is more than one, an application picks one by its label through `url_label`. Empty for a hosted server, whose address is Hush's to choose. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--urls))

<a id="nestedatt--tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--urls"></a>
